verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is an agentic payments platform, and a payments platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's transaction data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only payment primitives: agent tokens, passkey authentication, purchase-intent mandates, the Trusted Agent Protocol, and an MCP/agent toolkit for invoices and payment links. Nothing shows the product generating insights or suggestions from user data.
